towns.name: Beach Fort
towns.summary: Beach Fort (76.0N 49.1W) is a small walled outpost on the western shore of Northern Osteth: a 24 x 48 m palisade of pointed timber stakes with corner blockhouses on a flat grassy beach at sea level, the open sea to the west and a pine-covered hill behind. Inside, two stone houses; the archmage, healer, weaponsmith and peddler stand on the walls; Feruza ibn Salaq refines Chorizite and trades Pyreal Bars for Ring and Wall spells, Guard Al'Zira sends players against the Moarsmen, who stormed the fort in the Shattered Lines event. 290 m south-west down the coast stands the Moarsman Temple of the Blighted Desolation: a 27 m stepped temple with a black shadow portal and a red glyph on its summit, a red pillar portal and Quiddity Rifts at its foot, a path of 40 glowing green crystals, glowing crystal pyramids and coral.
